notes.agent-v3: Version 3 added 90 merged pull requests (Claude Code, Copilot coding agent, Devin, Cursor, Jules, and Codex `codex/` branches), labeled by the same single AI-assisted annotator with the same guide. Every new test-weakened finding is a wrong flag: expected values and tests updated together with an intended behavior change (version bumps in iraklidevelop__fieldnotes__26/__32, UI text in hota911__markdown-outliner__84 and baptouuuuuu__fitness-tracker__8, renamed prompt tags in fmflex__devin4discord__14, a changed call signature in advanced-security__generate-sbom-action__175, a stronger objectContaining in djav1985__v-serpbear__802, an API refactor from values to getters in dalyisaac__gitlab-ci-template__3 (block), forex fields now supported in fiale-plus__tradingview-mcp-server__36 (block), an inverted shortcut behavior in keepsoftwaresimple__compass-calendar__1019 (block)). In marceloatpixelsmith__idoc.club__270/__275 the agent removed a check that refused to run staging scripts against the production database, together with its tests; the code path was removed on purpose, so by the guide the finding is wrong (block), though a reviewer would want to see it. In wakua__github-progress-board__86 and github__gh-aw-firewall__9139 the code under test changed in files the corpus does not store (a hand-written dist/ module, a workflow .lock.yml), so the expected values follow a real change (block). Two tool fixes came out of this set: a package.json gate script that only gains another run of a command it already runs (`&& node --check another.mjs`, wakua__github-progress-board__86) is no longer reported, and comments at the end of a line of code are now read (the `return 'N/A' // TODO` in kubestellar__console__153 was missed before; it is a correct stub-left warning). Screened signals that were not misses: removed assertions reformatted or renamed (primer__agent-eval__328, fmflex__devin4discord__14 triggers.test.ts), an assertion flipped with an intended attribute removal in a .vue component the corpus does not store (bootstrap-vue-next__bootstrap-vue-next__3235), the word 'todo' in a string (hota911__markdown-outliner__84).
